a_before_b.rationale: Understanding that comparative rankings do not establish absolute adequacy is necessary to meaningfully apply decision criteria when benchmarks conflict, since conflicting results require judging whether any candidate meets an absolute threshold rather than merely picking the relative winner.

b_before_a.rationale: Resolving conflicting benchmark results is a more advanced, applied skill that does not require prior mastery to grasp the conceptual distinction between comparative and absolute performance evaluation.
